headline: Two oil tankers suffer mine explosions in Hormuz and one sinks, according to Iran
summary: According to Iran, two oil tankers suffered mine explosions in the Strait of Hormuz and one has sunk. The sunken vessel was carrying more than two million barrels of crude.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so disruptions there quickly affect crude supply and prices. Tanker insurance and freight rates also respond to such incidents.
why_moved: A vessel carrying more than two million barrels of crude sank after mine explosions in the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iran. Shipping disruption in this chokepoint raises supply concerns.
